lessons.trigger_condition: tablet installs OCR language data from a mutable upstream branch and validates only presence/size
lessons.symptom_summary: the same installer URL can later resolve to different model bytes while still appearing valid
lessons.fix_pattern: pin an immutable upstream commit and exact Git blob object/size, reject symlink targets and unapproved redirects, bound the download, fsync a no-follow exclusive temp file, then atomically replace and re-verify installed bytes

lessons.trigger_condition: surface/edge/corner or valuation evidence is missing, null, boolean, or incomplete
lessons.symptom_summary: partial evidence can otherwise be interpreted from remaining fields or pristine defaults and yield an unjustifiably high advisory grade
lessons.fix_pattern: require all grading evidence channels, map missing/invalid defect evidence to maximum risk, and reject incomplete valuation payloads rather than filling pristine defaults

lessons.trigger_condition: Pokemon generation inference falls back to release/copyright year for an explicitly Japanese card
lessons.symptom_summary: Japan-era transitions can be shifted by one generation when non-JP boundaries are reused
lessons.fix_pattern: keep set/regulation/card-number evidence primary and use region-aware Japanese year boundaries only as a conservative fallback

lessons.trigger_condition: OCR contains arbitrary year-like numbers or the user changes KR/JP/US region after generation inference
lessons.symptom_summary: unrelated 1996-2099 numbers can be mistaken for copyright years and a region change can leave an old generation result visible
lessons.fix_pattern: accept year fallback only with explicit copyright evidence such as ©/(C)/COPYRIGHT, preserve circled copyright normalization, and immediately recompute generation when region changes

lessons.trigger_condition: a marketplace page contains SOLD/SOLD OUT/판매완료 text outside the current product evidence block
lessons.symptom_summary: footer/recommendation inventory text can incorrectly promote an asking listing into sold or auction evidence
lessons.fix_pattern: promote sold/auction status only from local product evidence, treat SOLD OUT as stock state not transaction proof, and give explicit auction-result evidence precedence

lessons.trigger_condition: PSA 9+ cumulative likelihood and exact PSA 9 bucket share display/state math
lessons.symptom_summary: exact 8/9/10 buckets can be internally inconsistent or fail to sum to 100 when cumulative values are reused
lessons.fix_pattern: calculate bounded exact PSA 8/9/10/below heuristic buckets that normalize to 100 and retain PSA 9+ as a separately named cumulative display; label estimates as heuristic, not official statistics

lessons.trigger_condition: card number/name resembles a market record but explicit KR/JP/US edition differs
lessons.symptom_summary: a matching card number can otherwise attach a price from another language/region edition
lessons.fix_pattern: treat an explicit edition mismatch as a hard rejection before fuzzy/card-number market scoring

lessons.trigger_condition: a positive public exact company+grade price lacks structured provenance, USD/KRW is missing/invalid, or a card-core dependency is absent from the tablet runtime manifest
lessons.symptom_summary: static exact-grade values can lose auditability, missing FX can silently create a USD value, and startup can pass despite a missing grading/valuation/identity/security dependency
lessons.fix_pattern: require source/type/observation-time provenance for positive public exact-grade observations, preserve KRW but emit no USD without a valid bounded rate, and enumerate all card-core Python/JS/security dependencies in the fail-closed tablet runtime manifest
